about_blocks.text: The Resident New Life In Christ Program is available to men who are smitten by alcohol, drugs or other destructive substances and/or behaviors. The program is open to men demonstrating a need and a determination to work towards recovery within the Gospel-focused program. Most men stay from half dozen to 12 months, however longer stays are potential where deemed necessary. sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
